description: This PHP source file defines a class `CleanCacheCommands` that extends Robo Tasks to provide a command `cache:clean` (aliased as `clean:cache`) for cleaning various cache directories within the SuiteCRM project. It uses Symfony's Finder component to locate cache directories and provides an interactive or forced cleanup process.

classes.name: CleanCacheCommands
classes.description: A Robo commands class providing functionality to clean cache directories in SuiteCRM.
